title: Snorkel AI triples valuation to $3.5B as demand for AI training data booms | TechCrunch
summary: Snorkel AI, a startup that helps AI labs and corporations build training datasets and simulated environments, has raised a $350 million Series E at a $3.5 billion valuation. Marina Temkin is a venture capital and startups reporter at TechCrunch.
